items.title: Cloud for Data Storage and Blockchain for Supply Chain Transparency (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Cloud for Data Storage and Blockchain for Supply Chain Transparency (PDF 117, printed 113).

blocks.text: Cloud Computing kisanon, researchers aur policy banane walon ko zarai data ke liye barhne wali (scalable) storage aur tez rasai deti hai. Blockchain fasal ki paidawar aur taqseem ke har marhale ko record kar ke supply chain mein transparency lata hai, dhoka-dahi kam karta aur munsifana tijarat yaqeeni banata hai. Mil kar yeh technologies Pakistan ke mustaqbil ke liye paidar aur qabil-e-bharosa zarai nizam banati hain.

blocks.prompt: Smart agriculture mein Cloud aur Blockchain ka alag alag kaam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Cloud: kisanon, researchers aur policymakers ke liye zaraati data ki scalable storage aur tez rasai. Blockchain: fasal ki paidawar aur taqseem ka har marhala record kar ke supply chain mein shaffafiyat, dhoka (fraud) kam aur munsifana tijarat (fair trade).

blocks.prompt: Poore section 8.3 ka jaiza: Do ubharti technologies use kar ke kisi Pakistani shehar ke traffic masle ke liye mukhtasar khayal design karein, aur aik akhlaqi masla batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: IoT cameras aur sarak ke sensors chauraho par gariyan ginte, aur AI data se signal ka waqt badalti aur rush ka andaza lagati, nataij cloud wali app mein. Akhlaqi masla raazdari hai: number plates parhne wale cameras logon ka data mehfooz rakhein aur sirf traffic ke intizam ke liye use hon.

items: Cloud: zaraati data ki storage; Blockchain: supply chain ki shaffafiyat.
Mil kar: Pakistan ke liye paidar aur bharosemand zaraati nizam.
